messages:
Maya: Heads up — the Vercel preview for PR #428 (docs/preview-sidebar-fix) is still showing the old sidebar TOC. Looks like the generated nav didn't include the new 'Guides' section. Anyone else seeing this?
Jon: I can repro. On Vercel preview the site generator runs with NODE_ENV=production but DOCS_PREVIEW isn't set; our mkdocs plugin toggles a toctree build based on that.
Priya: Repro steps I used locally: `DOCS_PREVIEW=true mkdocs build && mkdocs serve -a 127.0.0.1:8000` — the sidebar appears correct. Without DOCS_PREVIEW it omits the /guides pages.
Maya: Ah — we set DOCS_PREVIEW for Netlify previews earlier but I forgot Vercel. That explains the mismatch.
Jon: Two options: (A) add DOCS_PREVIEW as a preview-scoped env var in the Vercel project settings, or (B) make the mkdocs plugin detect a file marker (docs/_preview_marker) so previews don't rely on envs. Option A is fastest.
Priya: If we go env route note that Vercel caches build artifacts; changing the env will trigger rebuilds but sometimes you need to nudge it. To force a fresh preview build: 1) push an empty commit `git commit --allow-empty -m "trigger vercel preview"` or 2) trigger a redeploy from the Vercel dashboard.
Maya: I'll add the preview-scoped DOCS_PREVIEW=true in the Vercel team settings and push the empty commit now.
docs-bot: Deploy started for preview PR 428 — build id 7a9f — status: queued
Jon: Also: for the PR description please include the local repro steps and note the Vercel env addition. That speeds reviews.
Priya: Adding the mkdocs CLI snippet to the PR description so reviewers can run locally: ```bash
export DOCS_PREVIEW=true
pip install -r requirements.txt
mkdocs serve -a 0.0.0.0:8000
```
Maya: PR updated with repro snippet and a note that Vercel preview env was added. @Ben can you take a quick look when you have a sec?
Ben: On it, will review in ~30 mins.
docs-bot: Preview build succeeded — url: https://preview.vercel.app/preview/pr-428 — status: ready
Ben: LGTM. Approving now. Small nit about a line wrap in the nav YAML but not blocking. Planning to merge in the overnight window (02:15 UTC) to avoid churn during daytime docs syncs.
Maya: Merged at 02:15 UTC and verified the production docs update included the new Guides section on the first deploy. Thanks for the quick turnaround :tada:
